status: Installed on node 172.16.16.17 at the user's request, after a rehearsal on the nested PVE lab. Not published.
what: The PVE Console entry is rendered by the shared pve-ui-overlays package instead of qsm-pve-direct's own dpkg-divert, so qsm-pve-direct and qdev-host-pve coexist in any install order. The upgrade takes the template diversion over from older qsm-pve-direct versions and removes the retired injector's bytecode cache and state.
build: The same recipe as exp223: core on 172.16.16.200 in /var/tmp/qsm-dev-trixie (browser_bridge and signal unit tests pass in the chroot), standalone and gateway there, portable Qt guest packages in /var/tmp/qsm-qt-bookworm-20261028 on the controller, then the LXC helper with that Qt deb. Scripts in dist/rdp-hybrid/deployment-exp226-20261108.

installed_on_the_node.kept: pve-manager 9.2.21 with the native viewer, qemu-server 9.2.11+shared3, pve-container 6.1.14+webrtc2, libpve-guest-common-perl 6.0.5+webrtc1, pve-ui-overlays 0.1.0, qdev-host and qdev-host-pve 0.3.0.
